name: Somchai Boonchu
bio:
Somchai Boonchu's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his university days. Originally studying statistics, he found himself drawn to the data-rich environment of a local racing team. After graduation, he combined his analytical skills with his newfound passion, working his way up from basic telemetry analysis to become a key figure in race strategy and performance optimization. He sees data not just as numbers, but as a story of the car's performance, driver's skill, and the track's challenges. 

At Dick Johnson Racing, Somchai is known for his meticulous approach and uncanny ability to identify hidden trends in the data. He's passionate about creating easy to understand visualisations that allow the team to make quick adjustments in high-pressure situations. His collaborative style and dedication to providing actionable insights has made him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a receding hairline
physical.description: Somchai is of medium build, with a focused and thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Insists on using a specific brand of green tea during races.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
